'''Kevlyn Torr''' is a woodsman from the [[Two Rivers]], who serves in the army of Lord [[Perrin Aybara]].

==Activities==
Kevlyn Torr tells Perrin of a [[bubble of evil]] where one hundred trees died and dried in a single night. Perrin tells him to harvest the wood for the fire.{{ref/book|14|44}}

==Trivia==
*Kevlyn Torr is named after Kevin Orr, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
